items.title: 12.11 Particles ke masses ke darmiyan forces ki theories (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.11 (PDF 275-276) in the book's order, with a tip and a self-check.

blocks.text: Particles ke masses ke darmiyan alag alag mediators (beech mein kaam karne wale particles) ke zariye interactions samjhane ke liye do theories hain: quantum field theory aur string theory.
1. Quantum field theory (kitab mein dono theories par '2.' chhapa hai)

Is theory ke mutabiq har particle ko ek field se dikhaya jata hai jisay quantum field kehte hain; yahi field ek mediator ke zariye ek particle se doosre tak force pohanchati hai. Maslan ek positive charged particle apne gird space mein electric field banata hai, aur isi field ke zariye qareeb ke negative charged particle ko kheenchta hai. Field ek particle se doosre tak energy aur momentum bhi le ja sakti hai. Tamam fields ki energy aur momentum quantized hai, yani chhote chhote packets mein. Jo quanta (packets) field mein ek particle se doosre tak energy aur momentum pohanchate hain, unhein field particles kehte hain. Is tarah particles ke interactions field particles (quanta) ke exchange (len-den) se samjhaye jate hain, aur yeh sab bosons hain. Electromagnetic force photons se (electromagnetic field ke quanta), strong nuclear force gluons se, weak force W aur Z bosons se, aur gravity gravitons se pohanchti hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har teer ke saath hum matter ke andar ek level neeche jate hain: molecule atoms se, atom nucleus aur electrons se, nucleus neutrons aur protons se, aur neutron ya proton quarks se bana hai. Size dekhein: 10⁻¹⁰ m ka atom 10⁻¹⁵ m ke proton se taqreeban ek lakh (10⁵) guna bara hai. Quark ka size 10⁻¹⁸ m se bhi kam hai.

String theory theoretical physics ka ek advanced concept (khayal) hai jis ke mutabiq universe ke fundamental particles points (nuqte) nahi balke nanhe vibrating (thartharate) strings (dhaage) hain. Yeh strings khule ya band loops (chhalle) ho sakte hain, aur in ki vibration ka andaaz particle ki properties, jaise mass aur force, tay karta hai. String theory 'theory of everything' (har cheez ki ek theory) ban sakti hai, magar experiments se abhi tak prove nahi hui.

blocks.prompt: Quantum field theory aur string theory ka short comparison (muqabla) kijiye.

rows: Har particle kisi field ka quantum (packet) hai
Har particle ek nanhi vibrating string hai, point nahi
Forces boson field particles ke exchange se: photons, gluons, W aur Z, gravitons
String ki vibration ka andaaz particle ka mass aur force tay karta hai
Standard Model ki base; experiments se achhi tarah test ho chuki
Gravity samet 'theory of everything' banna chahti hai; experiments se abhi prove nahi

items: Quantum field theory: har particle ki quantum field; forces field quanta ke exchange se, sab bosons: photons (electromagnetic), gluons (strong), W aur Z (weak), gravitons (gravity).

String theory: particles nanhe vibrating khule ya band strings, jin ki vibration mass aur force tay karti hai; 'theory of everything' ki umeedwar, abhi prove nahi. Scale: molecule 10⁻⁹ m se quark (10⁻¹⁸ m se kam) tak.
